name: Godot MCP Toolkit
description: 把 Godot 4.2+ 编辑器变成 MCP Server：在编辑器里创建场景与节点、读写 GDScript、编排动画与 Tilemap、启动试玩并回读运行中的节点与报错。

display_description.zh: 通过 MCP 驱动 Godot 4.2+ 编辑器：场景与节点增删改、属性读写、GDScript 读写与校验、Tilemap/动画/音频编排、试玩启动与运行时节点检查、编辑器与游戏截图、报错回读。全部在本机运行，不上传工程数据。需要 Godot 4.2+ 编辑器插件与 Node.js 22+。
display_description.en: Drive the Godot 4.2+ editor over MCP: create and edit scenes and nodes, read/write properties, author and validate GDScript, build tilemaps/animations/audio, start playtests and inspect live nodes, capture editor and game screenshots, and read back runtime errors. Runs fully locally with no project data uploaded. Requires the Godot 4.2+ editor plugin and Node.js 22+.

zh: 在当前场景里加一个 CharacterBody2D 玩家，带 Sprite2D 和碰撞体
把这个脚本里的移动逻辑改成支持手柄摇杆
启动试玩，然后告诉我玩家现在的位置和速度
读一下编辑器控制台里最近的报错并定位到对应脚本
给这个场景截图，确认 UI 布局是否正确
en: Add a CharacterBody2D player with a Sprite2D and a collider to the current scene
Change the movement logic in this script to support a gamepad stick
Start the playtest, then tell me the player's position and velocity
Read the latest editor console errors and point me at the script involved
Screenshot this scene so I can check the UI layout
